context: SE-AUTOMATION-001A identified reproducible read-only engineering operations (health, context reconstruction, task readiness, verification bundle, project consistency, traceability, skill/adapter conformance, checkpoint preparation) that are today performed by manually running several commands (doctor/validate/review/gate/capabilities/verify/implement) and hand-walking the persisted record graph. SE-AUTOMATION-001B-B0 was opened to define, before any implementation, a read-only aggregation surface and a machine-readable output contract. Constraints on disk: STATE_POLICY.md forbids new state/memory/workflow/context engines; EXECUTION_INTEGRITY.md keeps execution/receipt/digest as conventions; CAPABILITY_GOVERNANCE.md states governance is contractual, not a runtime sandbox; permissions.json forbids gate bypass and self-approval. A future SE-CONSOLE is a consumer, never a source of truth.
problem: How can SYSTEM-ENGINEERING expose deterministic read-only aggregation (health, context reconstruction, readiness, conformance, consistency, traceability) with a stable machine-readable representation, without adding authority, engines, a new persistent store, or new schemas, and without inflating the context sent to the model?

options_considered.option: Read-only native surface composed from existing se_core functions + a versioned JSON envelope contract + a minimum-context/on-demand policy
pros: Reuses evaluate_gate, _coverage_report, run_doctor, check_policies, resolve_plan, audit_contracts, all_collections
No new schema, no engine, no store; single source of truth preserved
Smallest sufficient context by default limits token use
SE-CONSOLE can consume JSON without becoming authoritative
cons: Requires an ADR + command-contract change to expose it (COMMANDS/commands.json + adapter regeneration)
Context relevance selection must be defined precisely

options_considered.option: Introduce a new core subsystem / aggregation engine / context engine
cons: Over-engineering relative to composing existing functions

options_considered.option: Persist an aggregated snapshot (SQLite/file) as the source of truth
cons: Duplicates canonical files; drift; contradicts ADR-0003 file-per-artifact and STATE_POLICY one-canonical-source rule
Lock-in; no capability SE does not already have; rejected by ARCH-ECOSYSTEM-001-05

decision: Adopt a READ-ONLY AGGREGATION SURFACE as a small native extension of the reference implementation (implementation deferred to an authorized later phase), governed by a MINIMUM CONTEXT / ON-DEMAND policy. The surface composes existing read-only functions only; it never mutates, never creates records, never bypasses or auto-passes a gate, and never grants authority. Its output is a versioned machine-readable envelope identified as `se.report/1`, with stable additive-only keys, reference-first lists (id + minimal fields, not full bodies), explicit epistemic labels, provenance per fact, and an optional/separable `observation` block carrying the only non-deterministic field (timestamp). DEFAULT = the smallest sufficient context; broader context requires an explicit scope (identity|work|authority|trace|deep). Context reconstruction (AUTO-02) is always available but never auto-executed per session. No new schema is introduced; field-level validation is deferred to the implementation phase. SE-CONSOLE remains a consumer only.
reason: Every operation is already computable from canonical files by existing read-only functions; composing them behind a stable envelope yields deterministic, auditable, portable output while preserving AUTOMATE OPERATIONS, NOT AUTHORITY and the single-source-of-truth rule. A default-minimum, on-demand scope model directly reduces the context sent to the model without promising any unmeasured savings.
consequences: This ADR records design intent only. Implementation proceeds in authorized phases: B1 = JSON output enabler (AUTO-16), then B2 = deterministic context reconstruction (AUTO-02), then B3 = skill/adapter conformance (AUTO-07/08). Exposing any new command requires the command-contract change process (COMMANDS/commands.json entry + ADR + tests + `se adapter opencode` regeneration + doctor/validate). The envelope's `contract` id and key set are frozen additively; existing keys are never repurposed. Broad context (LEVEL 3/4) is never returned by default. Any future request to persist aggregated state, or to let the surface approve anything, requires a new ADR and is out of scope.
